digest.component_or_area: capabilities tier derivation and verdict signing
propositions: Gateway-routed providers (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) incorrectly stamp verdicts as tier 'first_class' when no base_url is configured, misrepresenting provenance despite request traversal through an opaque intermediary capable of silent rewriting.

The tier derivation logic in capabilities.py only checks base_url presence, failing to account for the gateway/* provider family, which can manipulate requests identically to a configured base_url proxy.

Signed verdicts with misrepresented tier expose an attestation consumer to incorrect trust assumptions about provenance, violating the two-tier design intent to distinguish direct vs. intermediated runs.
Gateway providers must be classified as 'best_effort' tier to accurately reflect that request provenance transited an intermediary, not sourced directly from the named provider.
